title: LLV-GHL250C: compact classical half-log tables save logarithmic memory

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one physical LLV-GHL250C compact-classical implementation of proof.md executing the complete virtual.md reference program recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n)log2(n)+(3/2)sqrt(n))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Original half-log parameters, caps, partial finishing calls, failed work, all-modulus decoders and finite branch are preserved. The actual compact classical pools, full field/address decoding, original coherent controls, source moves, initialization and cleanup are charged. The sharper internal exponent sqrt(n)log2(n)/2+(11/8+1/2048)sqrt(n)+o(sqrt n) has exact positive gap255/2048 absorbing all polynomial compilation cost into the exact envelope. All five claims concern this same physical configuration.

For this same physical LLV-GHL250C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated CLASSICAL workspace is O(n^(5/2)/log2n) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. With ell=max(1,ceil log2n),lambda_bank=ceil(ell/2),E=2^lambda_bank,J=max(1,ceil(E/ell)), seven fixed classical regions of C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2)))*J bits each, C=2^48, cover the complete maximum address span. Full vectors use2^20ceil(n/ell) slots of16nE bits; completed two-label roots have a separate2^17n-slot pool of16n bits without E padding. Every tuple/input/source/decoder/arithmetic, free/qubit-ID metadata, frame/counter, controller/input/output and unused classical padding counts. Section3 proves actual fixed capacities and slot reuse. Packed cells remain ordinary CLASSICAL bits; no cost is transferred to quantum data storage. Since J=O(sqrt(n)/logn), total classical allocation is O(n^(5/2)/logn), jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GHL250C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Original retained phase indices, current coherent search/rank/residue scratch, source/LE/transforms and all failure/cleanup registers fit the fixed O(n) logical pool. The WHOLE quantum pool, unused padding, fair-coin and temporary source wires and growth overlap count. All large label/table/control records reside in separately counted ordinary CLASSICAL memory. Exact logical-state equivalence preserves the whole source/output law jointly with every other claim.

For this same physical LLV-GHL250C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired source copies number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Exact compact-classical compilation executes one physical acquisition per virtual acquisition and no others, preserving every failed/rejected/discarded/aborted request and the original caps. Full virtual8 proves main nCcap+K<=2^(sqrt(n)/2); finite lengths change outside constants. Classical/quantum zero initialization is charged time/storage, not source copies. Full-secret success at least1-2^-8 and every resource/error claim hold jointly.

For the same LLV-GHL250C algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
